## About
Gin Mill Card Club was born out of our love for the game of poker. There wasn't a place to safely and legally play poker in Lubbock, and we felt strongly about that, so we set out to build one right here in town.
We've since brought the same passion to Farwell, TX and the surrounding communities. Our goal is to keep setting the standard for card clubs in West Texas and Eastern New Mexico.
One regular put it this way: treat folks with respect and they'll treat you the same. It's a good little community of poker players, and there's always a seat for someone new.

## Services
- Daily tournaments: There's a tournament on the schedule every day, so you can drop in and play any night of the week.
- Rake-free cash games: Sit down at a cash game without the rake coming out of your pots.
- Snack bar: Grab something to eat between hands. One reviewer called our snack bar excellent.

## FAQ
Q: Is it legal to play poker here?
A: Yes. Gin Mill Card Club is a legal private poker club in Lubbock.

Q: Can I bring my own drinks?
A: Yes, we're BYOB.

Q: Do you have another location?
A: We do. Our Farwell club is at 812 Avenue A in Farwell, TX.
